Class GameController

java.lang.Object
com.example.cincuentazo.controller.GameController
public class GameController extends Object
Controller responsible for managing the main game view. This class coordinates the interaction between the user interface and the game logic. It handles card selection, turn management, machine actions, player elimination, and visual updates during the match.
Version:
1.0
Author:
José David Hurtado

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      public void initialize()
      Initializes the game scene and prepares the user interface. This method creates the game state, loads the player's hand, updates the last played card, and configures keyboard shortcuts.

    • selectCard

      public void selectCard(javafx.scene.input.MouseEvent event)
      Selects a card from the player's hand.
      Parameters:
      event - mouse event generated when clicking a card

    • sendInput

      public void sendInput(javafx.scene.input.MouseEvent mouseEvent)
      Processes the selected card and performs the player's turn. If the card is valid, it is played and the turn changes. If no valid card remains, the player is eliminated.
      Parameters:
      mouseEvent - mouse event that triggers the action
